why: Multiple post-snapshot papers (Davies & Gill 2024/2025, plus 2025-2026 follow-ups) improve upper bounds on specific Zarankiewicz numbers z(m,n;s,t) via a strengthened linear program, and a 2026 arXiv paper reports new bounds found via an LLM-driven evolutionary search, directly moving the problem's own extremal quantity.
